attchmntText: Avio Smart Market Stack Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Avio Smart Market Stack Limited approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended 30 September 2026. The company reported a net profit of 68.86 lakh rupees for the quarter, compared to 150.51 lakh rupees in the same period last year. Revenue from operations stood at 1,292.81 lakh rupees. The board also approved a proposed Rights Issue, which is subject to shareholder approval. The trading window for dealing in company securities remains closed due to the ongoing Rights Issue process. The window will reopen after unpublished price-sensitive information becomes generally available and 48 hours have elapsed. The statutory auditors issued a review report with no material misstatements noted, though they highlighted impairment of certain balances and pending regulatory approvals related to the Resolution Plan.
